description: This file defines a specification class 'CustomersBySearchSpec' used for filtering customer entities based on a search query. It leverages Ardalis.Specification to build read-only queries with optional filtering based on name, email, or phone.

classes.name: CustomersBySearchSpec
classes.description: A specification class for filtering customers based on a search term, used for count queries without paging.

methods.name: CustomersBySearchSpec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the specification with an optional search string and applies filtering conditions if the string is not null or whitespace.
